description: Trajectory-derived features: dog-leg severity (DLS) proxies from XYZ deltas, TVD/Z gradient, cumulative lateral distance from heel, XY displacement from heel, smoothed Z trend, and curvature proxies. These capture structural geometry that complements GR-based features.
implementation_notes: Compute deltas within each well (groupby well_id). DLS proxy = sqrt(dx^2+dy^2+dz^2) per MD step normalized by md_step.
Inclination proxy = atan2(sqrt(dx^2+dy^2), dz). Azimuth proxy = atan2(dy, dx).
Z curvature = second difference of z smoothed with rolling window 30.
Use GroupKFold(5) by well_id. Compare CV RMSE to exp_b001 (37.11). Add code to src/features.py.
